info.name: Finalysis API
info.description: Requests for the Finalysis backend, with tests. Run top to bottom against the local dev app (`./mvnw spring-boot:run`) on a **freshly reset** dev database (`scripts/reset-dev-db.sh`): setup creates the accounts, so a second run fails. File uploads use paths relative to the repo root: run newman from there (the README gives the newman command, which leaves out **7. Real-file test**), or set Postman's working directory (Settings → General) to the repo root. Folders 1 to 6 use only fictional sample data; **7. Real-file test** is for manual runs with your own file, selected in Postman.

item.name: 7. Real-file test
item.description: Manual testing with your own statements: select the file in the body of **Preview real file** and **Import real file** (and, for transfers between two of your accounts, **Preview real card file** and **Import real card file**), then run the requests one by one, top to bottom. Nothing is asserted: results are logged to the Postman console (View → Show Postman Console). Edit the accounts in **Create real account** and **Create real card account** first. The transfer and review-queue requests log counts, account ids and dates only, never amounts or descriptions. Not part of the newman run. Never commit real statements or paste their contents into this collection.
